newsitem.title: UK: Siebe gets approval for expansion in India.
newsitem.headline: Siebe gets approval for expansion in India.

text.p: British diversified engineering group Siebe Plc said it recieved approval from the Indian government to establish a fully owned unit in India.

The approval paves the way for an initial investment of 8.0 million stg and the formation of Siebe India, a company that will be the umbrella for manufacturing, engineering, project management and promotion, said the company.
Siebe India will develop engineering centres for industrial process control equipment and safety shutdown systems. A facility for the production of industrial valves is also planned.
